exposure: receiving care at Foderiket Midwifery Unit (FMU)
outcome: transfers to hospital (before and after birth)
maternal complications during labour and birth
need for additional medical treatment during labour and birth
neonatal transfer to Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
cohort: The study included 495 women who started care at Foderiket Midwifery Unit (FMU) in Oslo, Norway, between 2007 and 2011.
finding: The birth outcomes for women who started care at Foderiket Midwifery Unit (FMU) were comparable to those of other freestanding midwifery-led units in Western countries, with a low incidence of complications and interventions.
mod_finding: The study found that 2% of women were delivered by caesarean section and 4% by vacuum extraction.
